_comment: Curated Google Maps embed presets offered to users as an alternative to pasting their own embed code. To add a venue: open Google Maps, find the place, Share > Embed a map, copy the iframe, and paste ONLY the src="..." URL into embedUrl. The ?pb= URL is static, needs no API key, and never expires — but it is an undocumented Google format, so if a preset ever stops rendering just re-copy it. Keep ids stable and kebab-case; they are not stored on the event (only embedUrl is), so renaming an id is safe.
